meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会获得 Dial 电话通道:能通过 `dial` CLI 发短信、收 AI 语音来电,把短信/通话事件接入对话;还包含手机配对流程,只有配对过的号码能发短信进来。
howto.when: 当你想给 Claude 接入一个真实电话号码用于短信或 AI 语音电话时触发——例如说“添加Dial频道”或“帮我配一个Dial号码”。

say.text: 帮我接入 Dial 电话号码
say.note: 开始复制适配器并走 Dial 登录配对流程

say.text: 给 Claude 配一个能收发短信的 Dial 号码
say.note: 会引导你登录 Dial 并配对手机

say.text: 添加 Dial 频道,用来接 AI 语音来电
say.note: 会设置号码的来电问候语并注册来电处理

howto.what_en: After install, Claude gains a Dial phone channel: it can send SMS via the `dial` CLI, receive AI voice calls, and route SMS/call events into conversations. It also includes a phone-pairing flow so only a paired number can text in.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add Dial to Claude — e.g. “add a Dial channel” or “set up a Dial phone number” — to send SMS and take AI voice calls.

say_en.text: Set up a Dial phone number for Claude.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and starts the Dial sign-in and pairing flow.

say_en.text: Give Claude a Dial number that can send and receive SMS.
say_en.note: Walks you through signing in and pairing your phone.

say_en.text: Add a Dial channel for AI voice calls.
say_en.note: Sets the line's inbound greeting and registers call handling.
